en.name: AGCleaner
en.short_description: Memory cleaner, storage optimizer, performance booster —  iOS/Android/PC/Mac

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing AGCleaner.

Please read this before testing. AGCleaner as currently built is a three-tab interface demonstration, not a working cleaner. We would rather state that here than have you find it.

What the code does (lib/domain/cleaner.dart and lib/main.dart):
• The memory and storage gauges are constants. They start at 74% and 82%; "Optimize Memory" waits two seconds, sets them to 42% and 79%, and reports a fixed "1.84 GB" cleared. Nothing is measured and nothing is freed.
• The Contacts tab returns the same three hard-coded entries every time — John Doe, Maria Santos, Rahul Sharma. "Merge Duplicates" waits 1.5 seconds, empties the list and shows "Contacts merged successfully via Cloud API Gateway!". There is no contacts plugin in the build and the address book is never read.
• The Photos tab returns two hard-coded groups whose thumbnails are remote images.unsplash.com URLs drawn with Image.network. There is no photo-library plugin in the build and the photo library is never read.
• "Connecting Cloud Gateway…" becomes "Secure Cloud Gateway Active" after a 1.5-second timer. There is no gateway and no request is made.
• Nothing on screen tells the user any of the above.

Because of that the app asks for no permissions and declares no usage descriptions; the only network traffic in the whole app is those two Unsplash thumbnails. There is no account, no sign-in and no purchase. Crash reporting is Firebase Crashlytics only, and there is no advertising or analytics SDK.

If you do run it: launch, then use the System, Contacts and Photos tabs in turn and press the action button on each. The globe icon in the header changes the interface language.

This build is held internally for the reason above and should not be assessed against any listing that claims it cleans, merges or frees anything. We will resubmit when real contacts, photo-library and storage access are implemented.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.

_blocked.no_copy_drafted: No listing copy can be written. The app has no cleaning implementation.
_blocked.evidence: lib/domain/cleaner.dart is a state machine over constants: demoDuplicateContacts ('John Doe', 'Maria Santos', 'Rahul Sharma'), demoDuplicatePhotoGroups, initialMemoryUsed=74, optimizedMemoryUsed=42, clearedSizeLabel='1.84 GB', and fixed delays (scanContactsDelay=1500ms) that exist only to look like work. pubspec has no contacts, photo-library, or storage plugin. The app cannot read your contacts, cannot see your photos, and frees nothing.
_blocked.to_unblock: Implement real contact/photo/storage access, or withdraw the app. Any description of this build would be a fabricated claim and an App Store 2.3 rejection.
